question: In which year did Hindustani Classical vocalist Rashid Khan receive the Padma Bhushan award?
solution:
The correct option is __**2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rashid Khan was born on** 1 July 1968** in** Badayun, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• He is an Indian classical musician in the Hindustani music tradition and belongs to the** Rampur-Sahaswan gharana**.
 
• He was awarded the** Padma Shri**, as well as the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in** 2006**.
 
• In 2022, he was awarded the **Padma Bhushan Award**, India's third highest civilian award, in the field of Art.
 
• He also won **Global Indian Music Academy Awards (GIMA)** in** 2010** and** Maha Sangeet Samman Award** in** 2012**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• List of various awards given in the field of music:
 
 
• **Harivarasanam Award**
 
• **Kalidas Samman**
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar Award**
 
• **Kumar Gandharva Samman**
 
• **Mirchi Music Awards**
 
• **MTV Immies**
 
• **Tagore Ratna and Tagore Puraskar**
 
• **Sanatan Sangeet Sanskriti**
 
• **Swaralaya Kairali Yesudas Award **etc.
